outcome: blood loss (measured by vEBL and cEBL)
cohort: Pregnant women scheduled for cesarean section at Gulu Regional Referral Hospital in northern Uganda.
finding: The visual estimation technique significantly underestimated blood loss in up to 90% of cases compared to calculated blood loss, leading to undiagnosed PPH in 21% of cases, with advanced maternal age and chorioamnionitis identified as contributing factors to PPH.
mod_finding: The study found that visual estimation significantly underestimated blood loss during cesarean sections in 90% of cases.
cross-section timing: Performed during and immediately after cesarean delivery.
